name: IRIS: I'm Reflecting In the Silence
source:
The 90s. The Internet has yet to become part of everyday life. Desperate to find a friend, you decide to give this new way of communicating a chance. After all, it's just a conversation...⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ Right?..

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4992010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
90年代，互联网尚未融入人们的日常生活。迫切渴望交到朋友的你，决定尝试一下这种全新的交流方式。毕竟，这不过是一场普通的聊天罢了……⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀对吧？……
